**Stable ID:** `DATA-03.02` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 03 Modality coverage

Define identity, metadata and coverage rules for still-image and video datasets, including resolution, frame rate and annotation types.

## Deliverables

- Modality profile for image and video
- Annotation-type vocabulary

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`
- `schemas/modalities/image-video.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Profile cites the documentation conventions it adopts

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Resolution, duration and frame-rate units are explicit
- [ ] Person-depicting content carries a consent field
- [ ] Validator enforces the profile

## Non-goals

- Hosting thumbnails or sample frames

- [ ] `DATA-03.02.T2` Encode

  - [ ] `DATA-03.02.T2.S2` Add fixtures and tests
